verdict.rationale: dLocal documents Smart Fields for securely collecting card data inside the merchant's own checkout without full PCI scope, positioned as an alternative to Checkout Redirect. Its API also lets merchants build their own payment form with full control over look and feel, and returns the parameters needed to build a custom Pix UI. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of Smart Fields styling/customization options, evidence of native mobile app components/SDKs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
